title: Verify M9-C2 (backup/restore/rollback/data-integrity) against live Postgres
objective: Upgrade M9-C2 from BLOCKED to VERIFIED with durable evidence. In FWI-M9-023, C2 was left BLOCKED because the Postgres-backed backup/restore/rollback/data-integrity tests skipped without a live database. The live Postgres bridge now exists: foundry role + foundry db on cluster 18/main (port 5432), with FOUNDRY_LEDGER_DSN / FOUNDRY_PG_PASSWORD supplied via secrets/foundry_pg.env. With that env sourced, all 14 Postgres-backed tests (test_postgres_ledger + test_outbox_dispatcher: audit chain verify, idempotent replay, concurrency conflict guards, transactional outbox drain, at-most-once dispatch, retry/backoff, poll loop) RUN and PASS against the live database. Record C2 VERIFIED with evidence. C3 and C6 remain honestly BLOCKED (they require an actual deployed release to soak against / immutably record — no fabricated production evidence). M9 stays PARTIAL.
forbidden_actions: commit directly to a protected baseline
mark C3 or C6 as VERIFIED (require a real deployed release not present)
change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action
commit a real API key, DSN password, or signing secret to the repository

acceptance_criteria.description: M9-C2 recorded VERIFIED with evidence pointing at the Postgres-ledger surface (PR #58 merge + M2 postgres backend commit).
C3/C6 remain BLOCKED; M9 stays PARTIAL.
Contracts, secret scan, history-secret scan, schema drift, wheel, full test suite clean (with FOUNDRY_PG_PASSWORD sourced so Postgres tests run, not skip).
